title: A Quiet Confession
body: I love you. There, it's on paper now. Seems easier to say when you aren't looking at me.

title: Dear to Me
body: You have a way of making a cold room feel warm. I don't mean the fire.

title: A Tender Thought
body: I tried to make this rhyme. It was awful. I love you will have to do.

title: A Familiar Smile
body: There isn't much space on this scrap, but I wanted some of it to belong to you.

title: Poor Words
body: I like the quiet with you. Most people make me feel I ought to fill it.

title: Simple Happiness
body: I was going to write something clever. All I've got is that I'm very fond of you.

title: A Warm Heart
body: You make me smile like a fool. It's getting rather hard to hide.

title: Still Yours
body: I've crossed out three starts to this note. None said it any better. I love you.

title: Near in Thought
body: Some days I feel old and cross. Somehow there's still a soft bit of me that's yours.

title: A Shy Confession
body: I'd know your laugh in a room full of people. That's a nice thing to know.

title: Quiet Comfort
body: I'm not much for sweet words. But you matter to me, more than I'm any good at saying.

title: Ordinary Love
body: It still catches me off guard, how much I care about you.

title: Loved Deeply
body: I love you, even the bits that would drive anyone else mad. Perhaps those most of all.

title: A Foolish Heart
body: My hand shakes a little writing this. Nothing wrong with it. I'm just thinking of you.

title: Lasting Affection
body: You don't have to be cheerful for me. I like you on the grey days too.

title: An Unadorned Truth
body: A whole page wouldn't be enough. This little scrap will have to carry the rest.

title: A Heart at Ease
body: I keep trying to make this sound less foolish. It seems love makes fools of us.

title: Dear Beyond Reason
body: You're the first person I want beside me when the world gets too loud.

title: A Certain Feeling
body: I love you. I'm leaving that plain, before I spoil it with too many words.

title: Tenderly Yours
body: I dont know a grand way to say it. I'd choose you again.

title: Deepest Sympathy
body: I'm sorry. Everything else I put after that felt too small, so I'll leave it there.

title: No Right Words
body: I wish there were words that made a loss lighter. I haven't found them.

title: A Dear Memory
body: You needn't find an answer to this. I just wanted you to know I care.

title: In Sorrow
body: A quiet room can feel cruel after someone is gone. I'm so sorry.

title: Grief Has No Measure
body: I hope the good memories bring some warmth, even if they hurt a little too.

title: Kindly Remembered
body: There isn't a right way to grieve. Don't let anyone tell you there is.

title: The Weight of Loss
body: I'm sorry for your loss. That sounds thin on paper. I mean it with all my heart.

title: Shared Sadness
body: A life leaves more behind than an empty chair. I hope that brings you some comfort.

title: Gentle Thoughts
body: Some days are only for getting through. That is enough.

title: Love and Absence
body: You have my sympathy. I wish I had something better to offer than ink.

title: A Small Condolence
body: The world ought to stop for a loss like yours. It feels wrong that it doesn't.

title: A Dear Life
body: You needn't be brave every moment. Being tired doesn't mean you loved any less.

title: Through Sorrow
body: I hope there are gentle moments among the hard ones.

title: Quiet Sympathy
body: I'm thinking of you with a heavy heart. No fine words today.

title: Not Forgotten
body: You can miss someone and smile at a memory in the same breath.

title: A Gentle Memory
body: There are things a person never gets used to. I hope this grows easier to carry.

title: Words Beside Sorrow
body: I'm so sorry. Please don't feel you owe anyone a cheerful face.

title: A Life Remembered
body: Grief takes up so much room. I hope kindness finds a little room beside it.

title: With Compassion
body: I wish this were a note about anything else. You have my deepest sympathy.

title: Room for Grief
body: It hardly seems fair. I havn't anything wise to say, only that I'm sorry.

title: Another Year
body: Happy birthday. Another year older, and still more sense than most of us.

title: A Happy Milestone
body: Well done. I hope you're letting yourself feel proud of it.

title: Wedding Wishes
body: A new baby! Such a small person to take up so much of a heart.

title: A New Arrival
body: Congratulations to you both. May your marriage have plenty of laughter in it.

title: Well Deserved
body: Happy birthday. May your knees be kind and your cup be full.

title: Good Fortune
body: You deserve a good day. I hope this is the start of several.

title: A Proud Moment
body: That's something worth being proud of. Don't brush it off.

title: A Happy Occasion
body: A new home of your own. I hope it feels like yours before long.

title: Many Years Together
body: Congratulations. That little word looks too small for such good news.

title: Birthday Wishes
body: Happy birthday, you old goat. That's meant fondly.

title: A Fresh Chapter
body: A child brings so much hope into a room. Warm wishes to your growing family.

title: A Well-Earned Rest
body: To the newly married pair. May you be kind to each other when you're tired.

title: Simple Congratulations
body: Good news for once! It feels good just to put those words on paper.

title: A Reason for Joy
body: Another year. I hope there's more joy than worry in this one.

title: A New Beginning
body: Well done. You needn't be shy about enjoying it.

title: A Birthday Blessing
body: A fresh start is a fine thing. I hope yours is a happy one.

title: Joy in Small Letters
body: Congratulations on the little one. May there be strong lungs and a gentle temper.

title: A Year Worth Marking
body: Happy birthday. You're still younger than you will be next year.

title: Well-Earned Pride
body: I'm glad there's something to smile about. You deserve it.

title: Happiness to You
body: Congratualtions! I wrote that too fast. You know what I mean.

title: Much Valued
body: Thank you. I know it's only two words, but they're honest ones.

title: Quiet Gratitude
body: It's good to have someone like you in the world.

title: Old Friends
body: You're kinder than you need to be. I hope you know that.

title: Kind at Heart
body: I don't say it well out loud. I'm glad you're my friend.

title: A Good Friend
body: A small thank you, on a rather grubby bit of paper. It still counts.

title: Warm Appreciation
body: Some people make everything harder. You aren't one of them.

title: More Than Words
body: I hope you know how much you're worth to the people who care about you.

title: A Dear Friend
body: You make things feel a little less lonely. Thank you for that.

title: Remembered Fondly
body: This is just a friend's thanks. No great reason needed.

title: Honest Thanks
body: I'm not good at warm words. Please take these as warmly as I mean them.

title: Good in the World
body: You've got a good heart. Don't let anyone make you feel foolish for it.

title: Small Words
body: I like knowing there are decent people about. You're one of mine.

title: No Occasion Needed
body: Thank you. There ought to be a bigger word for it sometimes.

title: A Grateful Heart
body: Good friends are scarce. I'm glad I can count you among them.

title: Glad of You
body: I know I sound cross half the time. That doesn't mean I'm not grateful.

title: Friendship on Paper
body: You're a comfort to know. I thought you ought to hear it.

title: Simply Appreciated
body: There isn't any grand speech here. Just honest thanks.

title: A Rare Kindness
body: A kind heart is worth more than a heavy purse. Yours, anyway.

title: A Small Tribute
body: I'm glad of you. That's the whole note.

title: Warmly Valued
body: Thank you for being a freind. Apparently spelling is harder than gratitude.

title: Healing Wishes
body: I hope you're feeling a little better. A little counts.

title: A Little Comfort
body: Rest isn't something you have to earn. You need it, same as anyone.

title: Better Days
body: A bad day isn't a whole life. I hope tomorrow feels kinder.

title: Worthy of Kindness
body: You needn't put on a brave face with me.

title: Still Valued
body: Healing is slow, and waiting is rotten. I'm hoping for easier days for you.

title: A Slow Recovery
body: I wish you a quiet head, a warm bed, and a decent night's sleep.

title: Strength Within
body: You're allowed to be tired. Even the strongest back needs a rest.

title: In Hard Times
body: I hope the ache eases soon. It's miserable feeling unlike yourself.

title: A Gentle Hope
body: One small good thing can be enough for a day.

title: Faith in You
body: There's no shame in needing help. I mean that.

title: No Measure of Worth
body: I hope your strength comes back a little at a time.

title: Peaceful Wishes
body: You don't have to mend all at once. Slow is still mending.

title: A Setback
body: A hard winter doesn't last forever, though it can feel that way.

title: Dear to Others
body: Be as kind to yourself as you are to everyone else.

title: Quiet Encouragement
body: I hope something makes you laugh today. Even if it hurts a bit.

title: A Kinder Morning
body: I'm sorry things feel so heavy. You aren't weak for finding them heavy.

title: Strength Without Hurry
body: Some days keeping going is plenty. Don't ask more of yourself than that.

title: More Than a Hard Day
body: I hope there's less pain and more peace in the days ahead.

title: Hope in Plain Words
body: You matter, even when you don't feel much use to anyone.

title: A Patient Wish
body: I hope you feel better tomorow. And if not tomorrow, soon.

title: Valued Custom
body: Please count the crates before signing. It saves hard words later.

title: Respectful Regards
body: A fair price and sound goods. That's all I ask.

title: A Good Reputation
body: The coin needs counting twice. Trust is good. Sums are better.

title: Honest Trade
body: I'd rather hear a plain no than a yes that means nothing.

title: Mutual Respect
body: Good iron is worth paying for. Rust with a fine story isn't.

title: Plain Appreciation
body: A small shop can't afford large mistakes.

title: Pride in Craft
body: If the price has changed, put it in ink. My memory isn't a ledger.

title: Fair Dealing
body: I'd sooner keep a good customer than squeeze the last septim out of one.

title: Valued Trust
body: Please write the full amount. A smudge isn't a number.

title: Sound Work
body: There's room for both of us to earn a living. No need to make enemies of it.

title: A Fellow Tradesperson
body: A promise doesn't weigh much against an empty purse.

title: Good Standing
body: I don't mind a hard bargain. I mind finding a different one on the bill.

title: Worthy Skill
body: Dry goods need dry crates. That ought to go without saying.

title: Good Wishes
body: Good work deserves good pay. Cheap work usually costs twice.

title: Honest Measures
body: A tidy account makes for a peaceful night.

title: Respect for a Craft
body: I value steady trade more than a quick handful of coin.

title: A Customer's Regard
body: Please leave room for the tally marks. These margins are too narrow.

title: Worth More Than Coin
body: A price in writing is kinder to everyone.

title: A Tradesperson's Esteem
body: I'm happy with fair terms. I don't need fancy ones.

title: The Value of Care
body: Please check the reciept. The second figure is a seven, however it looks.

title: A New Neighbor
body: Welcome. I hope this place starts to feel like home soon.

title: Among Colleagues
body: New faces make a town less dull. I'm glad yours is here.

title: A Sense of Belonging
body: A warm hearth and quiet nights to you.

title: Settling In
body: It takes time to know a place. I hope it treats you kindly while you do.

title: A Kindly Welcome
body: Welcome, neighbour. That's a good word to have for someone.

title: Among Friends
body: May your roof stay sound and your door find friendly faces.

title: Glad You Are Here
body: I hope you find a corner of this place that feels yours.

title: A Comfortable Home
body: There's always room for one more decent soul.

title: Part of the Community
body: Welcome. No grand speech, just good wishes.

title: Warm Regards
body: Unfamiliar streets don't stay unfamiliar forever.

title: Finding Your Feet
body: A new start can feel rather lonely. I hope yours doesn't for long.

title: A Quiet Welcome
body: May the cold stay outside and the warmth stay in.

title: Room to Belong
body: Welcome to this little patch of Skyrim.

title: A Friendly Beginning
body: I hope the place suits you, draughts and all.

title: A Good Beginning
body: A town is only its people. I'm glad to have another neighbour.

title: A Place Among Us
body: May your days here be ordinary in the nicest way.

title: New Faces, Warm Wishes
body: I hope you can put your feet up and feel at home.

title: Kindly Neighbors
body: Here's a small welcome on a small piece of paper.

title: An Easy Beginning
body: New walls, new faces. I hope there's good in both.

title: Familiar in Time
body: Welcome, neigbour. My spelling's worse than my good wishes.

title: Pantry List
body:
Salt Pile
Bread
Red Apple
Honey

title: Useful Little Things
body:
Lockpick
Torch
Leather Strips

title: Three Good Qualities
body: Patience, honesty, and a sense of humor. Worth more than fine boots.

title: For the Alchemy Shelf
body:
Lavender
Blue Mountain Flower
Thistle Branch
Juniper Berries

title: A Modest Wish
body: A warm room, a sound roof, and enough bread. A modest measure of comfort.

title: A Line About Rain
body: Rain has a different voice on every roof.

title: The Shape of a Day
body: Morning light. Midday noise. Evening quiet.

title: Cloth and Leather
body:
Linen Wrap
Leather
Leather Strips

title: Words Worth Keeping
body: Enough is a kinder word than more.

title: A Short Provision List
body:
Bread
Goat Cheese Wedge
Elves Ear
Nord Mead

title: Materials List
body:
Iron Ingot
Steel Ingot
Corundum Ingot
Leather Strips

title: A Question on Paper
body: Is silence still silence when the kettle is singing?

title: Food and Drink
body:
Sweet Roll
Honey Nut Treat
Boiled Creme Treat
Alto Wine

title: A Verse of Pines
body:
The hills are gray, the sky is wide;
The pines stand dark on either side.

title: A List of Ingredients
body:
Frost Mirriam
Garlic
Juniper Berries
Snowberries

title: A Small Supply List
body:
Torch
Lockpick
Potion of Minor Healing

title: On Good Sense
body: A little good sense is less showy than a fine hat and rather more useful.

title: A Weather Thought
body: Snow makes even a familiar road look like a new thought.

title: Things for the Table
body:
Wooden Plate
Wooden Bowl
Tankard

title: A Pleasant Sound
body: A kettle, a hearth, and rain against a shutter. A fine little orchestra.

title: My Dearest
body: I love you. You know that, but I like putting it where you can read it too.

title: Always Dear
body: Being married to you still makes me smile. Rather silly of me, perhaps. I don't mind.

title: A Spouse's Affection
body: You get the best of my heart, even when the rest of me is tired and cross.

title: A Heart Beside Yours
body: No poem today. Just your spouse being hopelessly fond of you.

title: Our Quiet Happiness
body: Sometimes I think how odd it is that out of everyone, we found each other.

title: Few Words, Much Love
body: I like the life that has your name in it.

title: A Familiar Tenderness
body: You're still my favourite person. Even when you're being a nuisance.

title: Dearer Still
body: It's good, being us. I hope you feel that too.

title: Glad to Be Yours
body: I love you on the dull days as much as the bright ones.

title: Love Without Finery
body: I dont have anything clever to write. Just that I'm glad I married you.

title: An Unquiet Heart
body: You're married. I know. Knowing doesn't seem to help much.

title: A Bitter Little Truth
body: I wish I could be happy for you without that little twist in my chest.

title: Someone Else's Vows
body: Someone else gets to call you theirs. I find I mind that more than I ought to.

title: An Unwelcome Feeling
body: This is a foolish note. I'm jealous, and there's no nice way to write it.

title: A Quiet Envy
body: I keep telling myself to have some sense. So far it isnt working.

title: Confidence in Our Trade
body: Thank you for putting coin into {shop}. A small shop means an awful lot to the person keeping it.

title: A Merchant's Gratitude
body: Your coin in {shop} means more breathing room. I'm grateful for that.

title: Worthy of Trust
body: It's a good feeling, knowing someone thinks {shop} is worth backing. Thank you.

title: A Shopkeeper's Thanks
body: Thank you for the investment in {shop}. I'd put that more grandly if I knew how.

title: Respect and Appreciation
body: There's a lot of worry behind a shop counter. Your help with {shop} means a little less of it.

title: A Friend's Regard
body: It's good to know you. I don't say that often enough.

title: Glad to Know You
body: I'm glad we're friends. There doesn't have to be more to this note than that.

title: A Valued Friendship
body: The world feels a little less sharp with a friend like you in it.

title: Few Words of Thanks
body: I hope you know I think well of you.

title: Dear as a Friend
body: Some people are easier to be yourself around. You're one of them.

title: A Kindly Thought
body: A small note to a good friend. That's you, in case there's any doubt.

title: Friendship Enough
body: I'm glad of your friendship. My handwriting seems a poor way to show it.

title: A Good Person
body: It's nice knowing someone I can think of fondly without a long list of buts.

title: Appreciation in Ink
body: I value you. I know that sounds plain. It's meant warmly.

title: A Friend Well Valued
body: I hope life is being decent to you. You deserve decent.

title: Honest Affection
body: This is only a scrap of paper, but there's real fondness in it.

title: A Quiet Thank You
body: You're good company, even as a thought.

title: Warm Regard
body: There aren't so many good friends that I can afford to take one for granted.

title: No Grand Occasion
body: You have a place in my heart. A friend's place, before you get any ideas.

title: A Good Thing in Life
body: I'm glad you're my freind. Don't judge the spelling.

title: Plain Dislike
body:
{player_name},

I can't stand you. There. No need to dress it up.

title: No Warm Regard
body:
{player_name},

You think rather a lot of yourself. I think rather less.

title: A Bitter Opinion
body:
{player_name},

I have nothing kind to say about you, so this will be short.

title: No Fondness
body:
{player_name},

Even your name leaves a bad taste in my mouth.

title: An Honest Contempt
body:
{player_name},

I dislike you more than is worth the price of this ink.

title: Thoroughly Unimpressed
body:
{player_name},

There's no fondness here. I wanted that clear.

title: A Cold Regard
body:
{player_name},

I hope this is plain enough. I want nothing to do with you.

title: Little to Admire
body:
{player_name},

Some people improve a room by leaving it. You come to mind.

title: A Sour Sentiment
body:
{player_name},

My opinion of you hasn't softened. In case you wondered.

title: Without Affection
body:
{player_name},

You wear on the nerves, even at a distance.

title: Without Pretense
body:
{player_name},

I don't care for you. That's as polite as I can manage.

title: A Poor Impression
body:
{player_name},

I tried to think of something good to say. Empty page.

title: Undiminished Disdain
body:
{player_name},

If you think we're friends, allow me to put that right.

title: No Kind Opinion
body:
{player_name},

I have a low opinion of you and no wish to raise it.

title: An Unpleasant Thought
body:
{player_name},

I dont like you. You aren't worth another sheet of paper.

title: A Welcome to Breezehome
body: Welcome to Breezehome. Small rooms, but there's comfort in that. I hope Whiterun feels like home to you.

title: A Place in Whiterun
body: Breezehome is a good name for a place in Whiterun. May the breeze stay outside when the shutters are shut. Welcome, neighbour.

title: Welcome Beside the Water
body: Welcome to Honeyside. I hope your little corner of Riften gives you some peace.

title: A Riften Neighbor
body: A home by the water sounds a fine thing. Warm wishes for Honeyside, and welcome to Riften.

title: A Home Among Stone
body: Welcome to Vlindrel Hall. Markarth has a hard face, but I hope your home feels warm inside.

title: Warmth in Markarth
body: Those old stone walls at Vlindrel Hall have stood a long while. I hope there's a good, quiet life within them for you.

title: A Gentle Welcome to Hjerim
body: Welcome to Hjerim. Windhelm can be a cold place. I hope your hearth makes up for it.

title: A Hearth in Windhelm
body: A warm welcome for your home in Hjerim. It feels a small thing to send against all that Windhelm cold.

title: Welcome to Proudspire
body: Proudspire Manor is quite a name to put on a letter. I hope the place is as comfortable as it is grand. Welcome to Solitude.

title: A Place in Solitude
body: Welcome to Proudspire. I hope even a house that fine has a good chair close to the fire.

title: A Raven Rock Welcome
body: Welcome to Severin Manor. Raven Rock takes some getting used to. I hope the house helps you feel settled.

title: Warmth on Solstheim
body: Good wishes for your home at Severin Manor. There's warmth to be found in Raven Rock, ash and all.

title: A Quiet Riften Welcome
body: Welcome to Shadowfoot Sanctum. A quiet corner beneath Riften sounds rather nice, all things considered.

title: A Home Below the Streets
body: Warm wishes for Shadowfoot Sanctum. A place under the streets deserves a cheerful hearth as much as any other.
